title: Product Manual for Domestic Stainless Steel Vacuum Flask/Bottle According to IS 17526:2021
purpose: Guidelines for certification of Domestic Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks and Bottles under Scheme I (ISI Mark).

operational_guidelines.sampling_guidelines: Eight (8) samples drawn from factory production or market surveillance for complete testing.
operational_guidelines.scheme_of_inspection_and_testing: Routine factory quality assurance tests must include raw material verification, leakage testing, thermal heat retention, and impact drop integrity.
primary_test_equipment_required: Water bath / regulated hot water source (95 +/- 1 deg C)
Digital multi-channel temperature data logger (calibrated accuracy +/- 0.5 deg C)
Drop test apparatus with solid concrete impact target floor
Leakage test holding fixture with 10-minute inversion mechanism
Chemical testing spectrophotometer for stainless steel Grade 304 composition verification
Food-grade overall migration test apparatus as per IS 9845
